editorial:
Imagine being paid to spy on your ex-girlfriend, only to fall back in love with her while doing it. That is the messy situation Varg Veum finds himself in. He is a private eye who takes a job for his old buddy Jakob, who thinks his wife Rebecca is cheating. From the start, you can feel the tension. The movie has a cold, moody vibe that fits a crime thriller perfectly. You get to see a complicated love triangle play out while a dangerous serial killer is lurking in the background, targeting people close to Jakob. It is a wild mix of a romantic drama and a scary mystery that keeps you guessing about who is actually the bad guy.

What really works here is how the suspense builds up. The acting feels real, and the twists keep you on your toes without being too confusing. While some parts of the plot move a bit slow, the payoff at the end makes it worth your time. If you enjoy gritty detective stories with a bit of a heart, you should definitely give this a shot. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the moody lighting, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that the killings were not random. The killer was actually someone close to the circle who wanted revenge. Varg uses his detective skills to track down the culprit just before they can strike again. After a tense final confrontation, the killer is stopped. Varg and Rebecca finally find some peace, and the mystery of the band's deaths is solved, leaving the characters to pick up the pieces of their broken lives.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves detective stories and dark mysteries.
